---- MODULE W4Od0m9p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Slots, Instances, Surgeons

VARIABLES
  grants,   \* set of <<slot, surgeon>> currently allocated in the shared pool
  epoch,    \* current global reconfiguration epoch
  view,     \* [Instances -> Nat] epoch each instance believes is current
  pending   \* set of <<inst, slot, surgeon>> requests awaiting commit

vars == <<grants, epoch, view, pending>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ grants \subseteq (Slots \X Surgeons)
  /\ epoch \in Nat
  /\ view \in [Instances -> Nat]
  /\ pending \subseteq (Instances \X Slots \X Surgeons)

SlotOf(g)    == g[1]
SurgeonOf(g) == g[2]
SlotTaken(s) == \E g \in grants : SlotOf(g) = s

Init ==
  /\ grants = {}
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ view = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
  /\ pending = {}

\* An instance submits an allocation request under its current view
Submit(i, s, g) ==
  /\ view[i] = epoch
  /\ ~SlotTaken(s)
  /\ <<i, s, g>> \notin pending
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {<<i, s, g>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, epoch, view>>

\* Commit succeeds only under a fresh view and when the slot is still free
Commit(i, s, g) ==
  /\ <<i, s, g>> \in pending
  /\ view[i] = epoch
  /\ ~SlotTaken(s)
  /\ grants' = grants \cup {<<s, g>>}
  /\ pending' = pending \ {<<i, s, g>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, view>>

MaxEpoch == 2

\* Reconfiguration bumps the epoch and discards stale in-flight requests
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ pending' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, view>>

\* An instance refreshes its view to the current epoch
Refresh(i) ==
  /\ view[i] # epoch
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![i] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, epoch, pending>>

\* A completed surgery releases its slot back into the pool
Release(s, g) ==
  /\ <<s, g>> \in grants
  /\ grants' = grants \ {<<s, g>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, view, pending>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Slots, g \in Surgeons : Submit(i, s, g)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Slots, g \in Surgeons : Commit(i, s, g)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Refresh(i)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, g \in Surgeons : Release(s, g)
  \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No slot in the shared pool is ever granted to two different surgeons at once
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A x, y \in grants : (SlotOf(x) = SlotOf(y)) => (SurgeonOf(x) = SurgeonOf(y))

====
nl: A hospital operating-room scheduler runs two independent scheduler instances that draw operating-room slots from one shared pool. Surgeons are assigned slots. The configuration is versioned by an epoch; a reconfiguration bumps the epoch and discards all stale in-flight requests. An instance may submit an allocation request for a free slot only while its view matches the current epoch. A commit turns a pending request into a grant, but only if the instance still has a fresh view and the slot is still free. An instance may refresh its stale view to the current epoch. A completed surgery releases its slot back into the shared pool. SAFETY PROPERTY: no slot in the shared pool is ever granted to two different surgeons at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od0m5p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Slots, Holders

VARIABLES
  proposed,   \* set of <<slot, holder>> proposals currently open for voting
  ballots,    \* set of <<slot, holder, node>> votes cast
  grants,     \* set of <<slot, holder>> that reached quorum and committed
  capacity    \* number of rooms currently open (changes at runtime)

vars == <<proposed, ballots, grants, capacity>>

Quorum   == 2
MaxCap   == 3
SlotOf(p)   == p[1]
HolderOf(p) == p[2]
Taken(s)    == \E g \in grants : SlotOf(g) = s
VotesFor(p) == { n \in Nodes : <<p[1], p[2], n>> \in ballots }

TypeOK ==
  /\ proposed \subseteq (Slots \X Holders)
  /\ ballots  \subseteq (Slots \X Holders \X Nodes)
  /\ grants   \subseteq (Slots \X Holders)
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ proposed = {}
  /\ ballots = {}
  /\ grants = {}
  /\ capacity = 2

\* A scheduler opens a proposal to allocate a still-free slot
Propose(s, h) ==
  /\ ~Taken(s)
  /\ <<s, h>> \notin proposed
  /\ proposed' = proposed \cup {<<s, h>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ballots, grants, capacity>>

\* A node votes for an open proposal at most once
Vote(s, h, n) ==
  /\ <<s, h>> \in proposed
  /\ <<s, h, n>> \notin ballots
  /\ ballots' = ballots \cup {<<s, h, n>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, grants, capacity>>

\* Commit a proposal once a quorum has voted, the slot is free, and capacity remains
Commit(s, h) ==
  /\ <<s, h>> \in proposed
  /\ Cardinality(VotesFor(<<s, h>>)) >= Quorum
  /\ ~Taken(s)
  /\ capacity > 0
  /\ grants' = grants \cup {<<s, h>>}
  /\ proposed' = proposed \ {<<s, h>>}
  /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED ballots

\* Capacity is adjusted at runtime as rooms open or close
Rescale(c) ==
  /\ c \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ c # capacity
  /\ capacity' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, ballots, grants>>

\* A finished case releases its room
Release(s, h) ==
  /\ <<s, h>> \in grants
  /\ grants' = grants \ {<<s, h>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposed, ballots, capacity>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Slots, h \in Holders : Propose(s, h)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, h \in Holders, n \in Nodes : Vote(s, h, n)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, h \in Holders : Commit(s, h)
  \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : Rescale(c)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, h \in Holders : Release(s, h)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A slot never carries committed grants for two different holders
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A x, y \in grants : (SlotOf(x) = SlotOf(y)) => (HolderOf(x) = HolderOf(y))
====
nl: A hospital operating-room scheduler commits every allocation by quorum vote among three scheduler nodes. Holders request operating rooms drawn from a shared set of slots. A scheduler opens a proposal to allocate a still-free slot; each node may vote for an open proposal at most once. A proposal commits into a grant only once a quorum of two nodes has voted, the slot is still free, and there is remaining room capacity, which is decremented on commit. Room capacity is adjusted at runtime as rooms open or close. A finished case releases its room back into the pool. SAFETY PROPERTY: a slot is never held by committed grants for two different holders at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od9m4p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Commands, Workers

VARIABLES
  queue,       \* Seq of shed commands awaiting execution (bounded work queue)
  execLog,     \* Seq recording each irreversible shed action in order performed
  crashed,     \* set of workers that have crashed silently
  admitCount   \* [Commands -> Nat] how many times each command was admitted

vars == <<queue, execLog, crashed, admitCount>>

QCap    == 2
MaxAdmit == 2
Range(s) == { s[i] : i \in 1..Len(s) }

TypeOK ==
  /\ queue \in Seq(Commands)
  /\ execLog \in Seq(Commands)
  /\ crashed \subseteq Workers
  /\ admitCount \in [Commands -> 0..MaxAdmit]

Init ==
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ execLog = << >>
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ admitCount = [c \in Commands |-> 0]

\* Admit a shed command onto the bounded queue; backpressure blocks a full queue
Admit(c) ==
  /\ Len(queue) < QCap
  /\ admitCount[c] < MaxAdmit
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, c)
  /\ admitCount' = [admitCount EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<execLog, crashed>>

\* A live worker performs the shed at the head, but only if it was never shed before
Execute(w, c) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ Head(queue) = c
  /\ c \notin Range(execLog)
  /\ execLog' = Append(execLog, c)
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, admitCount>>

\* A duplicate of an already-shed command is discarded rather than re-executed
Drop(c) ==
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ Head(queue) = c
  /\ c \in Range(execLog)
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<execLog, crashed, admitCount>>

\* A worker crashes silently and stops processing
Crash(w) ==
  /\ w \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, execLog, admitCount>>

\* A crashed worker is replaced and rejoins
Recover(w) ==
  /\ w \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, execLog, admitCount>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Commands : Admit(c)
  \/ \E w \in Workers, c \in Commands : Execute(w, c)
  \/ \E c \in Commands : Drop(c)
  \/ \E w \in Workers : Crash(w)
  \/ \E w \in Workers : Recover(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Each irreversible shed action appears at most once in the execution log
ShedAtMostOnce ==
  \A i, j \in 1..Len(execLog) : (execLog[i] = execLog[j]) => (i = j)
====
nl: A power-grid load shedder queues shed commands onto a bounded work queue with backpressure: a command can only be admitted while the queue has room, and each command may be admitted a bounded number of times. Live workers pull the command at the head of the queue and perform the shed, which is irreversible, but only if that command has never been shed before; the action is recorded in an execution log. A duplicate of an already-shed command sitting at the head is discarded rather than re-executed. A worker may crash silently and stop processing, and a crashed worker may later be replaced and rejoin. SAFETY PROPERTY: each irreversible shed action appears at most once in the execution log.

---- MODULE W4Od7m4p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Tasks, Instances, Authorized

VARIABLES
  queue,    \* Seq of container tasks in the shared bounded pool
  epoch,    \* current pool configuration epoch
  lease,    \* [Instances -> Nat] each instance's lease epoch
  acting    \* [Instances -> Tasks \cup {"idle"}] task each instance is handling

vars == <<queue, epoch, lease, acting>>

QCap     == 2
MaxEpoch == 2
Idle     == "idle"
Range(s) == { s[i] : i \in 1..Len(s) }

TypeOK ==
  /\ queue \in Seq(Tasks)
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ lease \in [Instances -> 0..MaxEpoch]
  /\ acting \in [Instances -> Tasks \cup {Idle}]

Init ==
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ lease = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
  /\ acting = [i \in Instances |-> Idle]

\* A task is enqueued into the shared pool; backpressure caps the queue length
Enqueue(t) ==
  /\ Len(queue) < QCap
  /\ t \notin Range(queue)
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, t)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, lease, acting>>

\* Only an authorized, non-stale instance may start the task at the head
Start(i, t) ==
  /\ i \in Authorized
  /\ lease[i] = epoch
  /\ acting[i] = Idle
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ Head(queue) = t
  /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![i] = t]
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, lease>>

\* An instance finishes its task and goes idle
Finish(i) ==
  /\ acting[i] # Idle
  /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![i] = Idle]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, epoch, lease>>

\* Reconfiguration bumps the pool epoch, making all outstanding leases stale
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ \A i \in Instances : acting[i] = Idle
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, lease, acting>>

\* An authorized instance renews its lease to the current epoch
Renew(i) ==
  /\ i \in Authorized
  /\ lease[i] # epoch
  /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![i] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, epoch, acting>>

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Tasks : Enqueue(t)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, t \in Tasks : Start(i, t)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Finish(i)
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Renew(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No instance is ever handling a task unless it is authorized and holds a fresh lease
NoStaleActor ==
  \A i \in Instances :
    acting[i] # Idle => (i \in Authorized /\ lease[i] = epoch)
====
nl: A container-ship crane yard runs two authorized crane instances that share one bounded pool of container tasks, alongside a third instance that is not authorized. Tasks are enqueued into the shared pool with backpressure that caps the queue length. Only an authorized instance holding a lease that matches the current pool epoch may start the task at the head of the queue; it then handles that task until it finishes and goes idle. Reconfiguration bumps the pool epoch, making every outstanding lease stale, and an authorized instance may renew its lease back to the current epoch. SAFETY PROPERTY: no instance is ever handling a task unless it is authorized and holds a lease matching the current epoch.

---- MODULE W4Od13m3p2t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Machines, Nodes

VARIABLES
  vault,   \* units of stock still in the shared central vault
  stock,   \* [Machines -> Nat] units currently loaded in each machine
  sold,    \* units that have been vended out to customers
  leader,  \* the node currently elected leader, or "none"
  term     \* current election term (increases on each failover)

vars == <<vault, stock, sold, leader, term>>

None    == "none"
MaxTerm == 3
Total   == 3

Sum(f, S) == LET g[T \in SUBSET S] ==
                  IF T = {} THEN 0
                  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in T : TRUE
                       IN f[x] + g[T \ {x}]
             IN g[S]

TypeOK ==
  /\ vault \in 0..Total
  /\ stock \in [Machines -> 0..Total]
  /\ sold \in 0..Total
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm

Init ==
  /\ vault = Total
  /\ stock = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
  /\ sold = 0
  /\ leader = None
  /\ term = 0

\* The leader authorizes moving one unit from the shared vault into a machine
Refill(m) ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ vault > 0
  /\ vault' = vault - 1
  /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![m] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sold, leader, term>>

\* The leader authorizes a vend, moving one unit from a machine out to a customer
Vend(m) ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ stock[m] > 0
  /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![m] = @ - 1]
  /\ sold' = sold + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, leader, term>>

\* The current leader crashes, leaving the network without a leader
CrashLeader ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, stock, sold, term>>

\* A new leader is elected on failover, advancing the term
Elect(n) ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE MaxTerm
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vault, stock, sold>>

Next ==
  \/ \E m \in Machines : Refill(m)
  \/ \E m \in Machines : Vend(m)
  \/ CrashLeader
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The total number of units is conserved across vault, machines, and sales
Conservation ==
  vault + Sum(stock, Machines) + sold = Total
====
nl: A vending machine network manages a fleet of two machines that share one central stock vault, coordinated by an elected leader among the nodes. Only while a leader is elected may the network act: the leader authorizes a refill that moves one unit from the shared vault into a machine, or authorizes a vend that moves one unit from a machine out to a customer as a sale. The current leader may crash, leaving the network leaderless, and on failover a new leader is elected, advancing the election term. No action creates or destroys units; every unit is only ever moved between the vault, the machines, and the sold total. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of units across the vault, all machines, and completed sales is always conserved and equal to the initial total.

---- MODULE W4Od14m4p2t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Drones, Zones

VARIABLES
  reserve,    \* surveillance tasks not yet dispatched, held in the shared reserve
  queue,      \* Seq of tasks on the bounded dispatch queue
  active,     \* [Drones -> Nat] tasks each drone is currently flying
  completed   \* tasks fully surveyed and archived

vars == <<reserve, queue, active, completed>>

QCap  == 2
Total == 3

Sum(f, S) == LET g[T \in SUBSET S] ==
                  IF T = {} THEN 0
                  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in T : TRUE
                       IN f[x] + g[T \ {x}]
             IN g[S]

TypeOK ==
  /\ reserve \in 0..Total
  /\ queue \in Seq(Zones)
  /\ active \in [Drones -> 0..Total]
  /\ completed \in 0..Total

Init ==
  /\ reserve = Total
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ active = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
  /\ completed = 0

\* Dispatch a task from the reserve onto the bounded queue; backpressure caps length
Dispatch(z) ==
  /\ reserve > 0
  /\ Len(queue) < QCap
  /\ reserve' = reserve - 1
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, z)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<active, completed>>

\* A drone claims the task at the head of the queue and begins flying it
Claim(d, z) ==
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ Head(queue) = z
  /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![d] = @ + 1]
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reserve, completed>>

\* A drone finishes surveying and archives the task
Archive(d) ==
  /\ active[d] > 0
  /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![d] = @ - 1]
  /\ completed' = completed + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reserve, queue>>

\* A drone aborts and returns its task to the shared reserve
Abort(d) ==
  /\ active[d] > 0
  /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![d] = @ - 1]
  /\ reserve' = reserve + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, completed>>

\* An archived zone is recycled back into the reserve for a fresh survey pass
Recycle ==
  /\ completed > 0
  /\ completed' = completed - 1
  /\ reserve' = reserve + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, active>>

Next ==
  \/ \E z \in Zones : Dispatch(z)
  \/ \E d \in Drones, z \in Zones : Claim(d, z)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Archive(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Abort(d)
  \/ Recycle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The total number of surveillance tasks is conserved across all stages
Conservation ==
  reserve + Len(queue) + Sum(active, Drones) + completed = Total
====
nl: A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares one reserve of surveillance tasks across two drones connected by a bounded dispatch queue with backpressure. A task is dispatched from the shared reserve onto the queue only while the queue has room. A drone claims the task at the head of the queue and begins flying it, and later either archives it as completed or aborts and returns it to the shared reserve. Every task moves between the reserve, the dispatch queue, the drones in flight, and the completed archive without ever being created or destroyed. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of surveillance tasks across the reserve, the dispatch queue, the drones in flight, and the completed archive is always conserved and equal to the initial total.

---- MODULE W4Od10m2p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Blocks, Trains, Participants

VARIABLES
  proposal,   \* the <<block, train>> allocation currently under two-phase commit, or "none"
  votes,      \* [Participants -> {"none","yes","no"}] votes in the current phase
  held,       \* set of <<block, train>> allocations that have committed
  crashed     \* set of participants that have crashed silently

vars == <<proposal, votes, held, crashed>>

NoProp == "none"
BlockOf(g) == g[1]
TrainOf(g) == g[2]
BlockHeld(b) == \E g \in held : BlockOf(g) = b

TypeOK ==
  /\ proposal \in (Blocks \X Trains) \cup {NoProp}
  /\ votes \in [Participants -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
  /\ held \subseteq (Blocks \X Trains)
  /\ crashed \subseteq Participants

Init ==
  /\ proposal = NoProp
  /\ votes = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ held = {}
  /\ crashed = {}

\* The coordinator opens a two-phase commit to allocate a currently-free block
Propose(b, t) ==
  /\ proposal = NoProp
  /\ ~BlockHeld(b)
  /\ proposal' = <<b, t>>
  /\ votes' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, crashed>>

\* A live participant casts its prepare-phase vote
Vote(pt, v) ==
  /\ proposal # NoProp
  /\ pt \notin crashed
  /\ votes[pt] = "none"
  /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![pt] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, held, crashed>>

\* Commit only when every live participant has voted yes and the block is still free
Commit ==
  /\ proposal # NoProp
  /\ \A pt \in Participants : pt \in crashed \/ votes[pt] = "yes"
  /\ ~BlockHeld(BlockOf(proposal))
  /\ held' = held \cup {proposal}
  /\ proposal' = NoProp
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, crashed>>

\* Abort the transaction if any live participant voted no
Abort ==
  /\ proposal # NoProp
  /\ \E pt \in Participants : pt \notin crashed /\ votes[pt] = "no"
  /\ proposal' = NoProp
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, held, crashed>>

\* A participant crashes silently
Crash(pt) ==
  /\ pt \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {pt}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, votes, held>>

\* A train clears its block, releasing the allocation
Release(b, t) ==
  /\ <<b, t>> \in held
  /\ held' = held \ {<<b, t>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, votes, crashed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Blocks, t \in Trains : Propose(b, t)
  \/ \E pt \in Participants, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(pt, v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ \E pt \in Participants : Crash(pt)
  \/ \E b \in Blocks, t \in Trains : Release(b, t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No signalling block is ever allocated to two different trains at once
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A x, y \in held : (BlockOf(x) = BlockOf(y)) => (TrainOf(x) = TrainOf(y))
====
nl: A subway signalling block system allocates track blocks to trains via two-phase commit across signal participants. The coordinator opens a transaction to allocate a currently-free block to a train and resets the prepare-phase votes; each live participant casts a single yes or no vote. The transaction commits only when every live participant has voted yes and the block is still free, adding the allocation to the held set; it aborts if any live participant voted no. A participant may crash silently, in which case its vote is no longer required for commit. A train later clears its block, releasing the allocation. SAFETY PROPERTY: no signalling block is ever allocated to two different trains at the same time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m8p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Aircraft, Runways

VARIABLES
  waiting,    \* aircraft still holding in the waiting stack
  onRunway,   \* aircraft currently occupying a runway
  landed,     \* aircraft that have completed landing
  zoneLock,   \* holder of the coarse approach-zone lock, or "free"
  fineLock,   \* [Runways -> Aircraft \cup {"free"}] fine per-runway lock holder
  capacity    \* number of runways currently usable (changes at runtime)

vars == <<waiting, onRunway, landed, zoneLock, fineLock, capacity>>

Free  == "free"
Total == 3
MaxCap == 2

TypeOK ==
  /\ waiting \in 0..Total
  /\ onRunway \in 0..Total
  /\ landed \in 0..Total
  /\ zoneLock \in Aircraft \cup {Free}
  /\ fineLock \in [Runways -> Aircraft \cup {Free}]
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ waiting = Total
  /\ onRunway = 0
  /\ landed = 0
  /\ zoneLock = Free
  /\ fineLock = [r \in Runways |-> Free]
  /\ capacity = 2

\* Acquire the coarse approach-zone lock (hierarchical: coarse first)
AcquireZone(a) ==
  /\ zoneLock = Free
  /\ zoneLock' = a
  /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, onRunway, landed, fineLock, capacity>>

\* With the zone lock held, acquire a fine per-runway lock while capacity remains
AcquireRunway(a, r) ==
  /\ zoneLock = a
  /\ fineLock[r] = Free
  /\ capacity > 0
  /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![r] = a]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, onRunway, landed, zoneLock, capacity>>

\* Holding both locks, move one aircraft from the waiting stack onto the runway
TakeRunway(a, r) ==
  /\ zoneLock = a
  /\ fineLock[r] = a
  /\ waiting > 0
  /\ waiting' = waiting - 1
  /\ onRunway' = onRunway + 1
  /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![r] = Free]
  /\ zoneLock' = Free
  /\ UNCHANGED <<landed, capacity>>

\* An aircraft completes its landing
Land ==
  /\ onRunway > 0
  /\ onRunway' = onRunway - 1
  /\ landed' = landed + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, zoneLock, fineLock, capacity>>

\* A landed aircraft departs and a fresh arrival re-enters the waiting stack
Recycle ==
  /\ landed > 0
  /\ landed' = landed - 1
  /\ waiting' = waiting + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<onRunway, zoneLock, fineLock, capacity>>

\* Runway capacity is adjusted at runtime as runways open or close
Rescale(c) ==
  /\ c \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ c # capacity
  /\ capacity' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<waiting, onRunway, landed, zoneLock, fineLock>>

Next ==
  \/ \E a \in Aircraft : AcquireZone(a)
  \/ \E a \in Aircraft, r \in Runways : AcquireRunway(a, r)
  \/ \E a \in Aircraft, r \in Runways : TakeRunway(a, r)
  \/ Land
  \/ Recycle
  \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : Rescale(c)

Holding both locks, one aircraft moves from the waiting stack onto the runway, releasing both locks. An aircraft on a runway completes its landing, and a landed aircraft later departs while a fresh arrival re-enters the waiting stack. Runway capacity is adjusted at runtime as runways open or close, which limits how many fine locks can be held. Aircraft only ever move between the waiting stack, the runways, and the landed count; none are created or destroyed. ---- MODULE W4Od9m5p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Authorized, Proposals

VARIABLES
  credEpoch,   \* current credential epoch; rotated to revoke stale nodes
  nodeEpoch,   \* [Nodes -> Nat] credential epoch each node currently carries
  tally,       \* set of <<proposal, node>> votes accepted so far
  decided      \* set of proposals that have reached quorum

vars == <<credEpoch, nodeEpoch, tally, decided>>

Quorum   == 2
MaxEpoch == 2
VotersOf(p) == { n \in Nodes : <<p, n>> \in tally }

TypeOK ==
  /\ credEpoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ nodeEpoch \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxEpoch]
  /\ tally \subseteq (Proposals \X Nodes)
  /\ decided \subseteq Proposals

Init ==
  /\ credEpoch = 0
  /\ nodeEpoch = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
  /\ tally = {}
  /\ decided = {}

\* Only an authorized node carrying the current credential epoch may cast a vote;
\* reordered arrival is modelled by votes being accepted in any order
CastVote(p, n) ==
  /\ n \in Authorized
  /\ nodeEpoch[n] = credEpoch
  /\ <<p, n>> \notin tally
  /\ tally' = tally \cup {<<p, n>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<credEpoch, nodeEpoch, decided>>

\* A proposal with a quorum of accepted votes is decided
Decide(p) ==
  /\ Cardinality(VotersOf(p)) >= Quorum
  /\ p \notin decided
  /\ decided' = decided \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<credEpoch, nodeEpoch, tally>>

\* Rotating the credential epoch revokes stale nodes and discards their pending votes
Rotate ==
  /\ credEpoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ credEpoch' = credEpoch + 1
  /\ tally' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<nodeEpoch, decided>>

\* An authorized node renews its credential to the current epoch
Renew(n) ==
  /\ n \in Authorized
  /\ nodeEpoch[n] # credEpoch
  /\ nodeEpoch' = [nodeEpoch EXCEPT ![n] = credEpoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<credEpoch, tally, decided>>

\* A superseded vote is dropped from the tally (reordered or lost message)
DropVote(p, n) ==
  /\ <<p, n>> \in tally
  /\ tally' = tally \ {<<p, n>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<credEpoch, nodeEpoch, decided>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Proposals, n \in Nodes : CastVote(p, n)
  \/ \E p \in Proposals : Decide(p)
  \/ Rotate
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Renew(n)
  \/ \E p \in Proposals, n \in Nodes : DropVote(p, n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every accepted vote belongs to an authorized node carrying the current credential
NoStaleVote ==
  \A p \in Proposals, n \in Nodes :
    <<p, n>> \in tally => (n \in Authorized /\ nodeEpoch[n] = credEpoch)
====

Votes may arrive in any order, so accepted votes accumulate as an unordered tally. Only an authorized node whose credential matches the current epoch may cast a vote, and no node may vote twice for the same proposal. A proposal that accumulates a quorum of accepted votes is decided. Rotating the credential epoch revokes stale nodes and discards their pending votes, and an authorized node may renew its credential to the current epoch. SAFETY PROPERTY: every accepted vote in the tally belongs to an authorized node carrying the current credential epoch.

---- MODULE W4Od11m9p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Printers, Jobs

VARIABLES
  token,     \* [Printers -> Jobs \cup {"free"}] holder of each printer's exclusive token
  inCS,      \* [Jobs -> Printers \cup {"none"}] printer a job is currently printing on
  reqEpoch,  \* [Jobs -> Nat] epoch under which a job registered its request
  epoch,     \* current configuration epoch
  crashed    \* set of jobs whose owning client crashed silently

vars == <<token, inCS, reqEpoch, epoch, crashed>>

Free     == "free"
NoP      == "none"
MaxEpoch == 2

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in [Printers -> Jobs \cup {Free}]
  /\ inCS \in [Jobs -> Printers \cup {NoP}]
  /\ reqEpoch \in [Jobs -> 0..MaxEpoch]
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ crashed \subseteq Jobs

Init ==
  /\ token = [p \in Printers |-> Free]
  /\ inCS = [j \in Jobs |-> NoP]
  /\ reqEpoch = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ crashed = {}

\* A job registers its print request under the current configuration epoch
Register(j) ==
  /\ reqEpoch[j] # epoch
  /\ reqEpoch' = [reqEpoch EXCEPT ![j] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, inCS, epoch, crashed>>

\* A registered, live job grabs a free printer's token and enters its critical section
Acquire(p, j) ==
  /\ j \notin crashed
  /\ reqEpoch[j] = epoch
  /\ token[p] = Free
  /\ inCS[j] = NoP
  /\ token' = [token EXCEPT ![p] = j]
  /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![j] = p]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reqEpoch, epoch, crashed>>

\* A job leaves its critical section and returns the printer's token
Release(p, j) ==
  /\ inCS[j] = p
  /\ token[p] = j
  /\ token' = [token EXCEPT ![p] = Free]
  /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![j] = NoP]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reqEpoch, epoch, crashed>>

\* Reconfiguration advances the epoch, staling every outstanding registration
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, inCS, reqEpoch, crashed>>

\* A job's client crashes; it drops out of its critical section and frees its token
Crash(p, j) ==
  /\ j \notin crashed
  /\ inCS[j] = p
  /\ token' = [token EXCEPT ![p] = Free]
  /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![j] = NoP]
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reqEpoch, epoch>>

\* A crashed client is restarted and rejoins the spooler
Recover(j) ==
  /\ j \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, inCS, reqEpoch, epoch>>

Next ==
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Register(j)
  \/ \E p \in Printers, j \in Jobs : Acquire(p, j)
  \/ \E p \in Printers, j \in Jobs : Release(p, j)
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E p \in Printers, j \in Jobs : Crash(p, j)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Recover(j)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A job may occupy a printer's critical section only while it holds that printer's token
Mutex ==
  \A j \in Jobs : inCS[j] # NoP => token[inCS[j]] = j
====
nl: A print shop job spooler grants exclusive access to printers, each guarded by a single token, under an epoch-numbered configuration. A job registers its print request under the current epoch. A registered, live job may grab a free printer's token and enter that printer's critical section; because the token is single-valued, only one job can occupy a printer at a time. A job leaves its critical section and returns the token. Reconfiguration advances the epoch, staling every outstanding registration so it must be renewed before another acquire. A job's client may crash silently, dropping it out of its critical section and freeing the printer's token. SAFETY PROPERTY: a job may occupy a printer's critical section only while it holds that printer's exclusive token.

---- MODULE W4Od4m4p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cars, Bays

VARIABLES
  belt,      \* Seq of cars on the bounded conveyor belt awaiting the seal coat
  sealLog,   \* Seq recording each irreversible seal-coat application in order
  offBelt,   \* set of cars that have left the belt without a second pass
  broken     \* set of bays that have broken down

vars == <<belt, sealLog, offBelt, broken>>

BeltCap  == 2
Range(s) == { s[i] : i \in 1..Len(s) }

TypeOK ==
  /\ belt \in Seq(Cars)
  /\ sealLog \in Seq(Cars)
  /\ offBelt \subseteq Cars
  /\ broken \subseteq Bays

Init ==
  /\ belt = << >>
  /\ sealLog = << >>
  /\ offBelt = {}
  /\ broken = {}

\* A car mounts the bounded conveyor belt; a full belt applies backpressure
Mount(c) ==
  /\ Len(belt) < BeltCap
  /\ c \notin Range(belt)
  /\ c \notin Range(sealLog)
  /\ belt' = Append(belt, c)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sealLog, offBelt, broken>>

\* A working bay applies the irreversible seal coat to the car at the head, once
Seal(b, c) ==
  /\ b \notin broken
  /\ Len(belt) > 0
  /\ Head(belt) = c
  /\ c \notin Range(sealLog)
  /\ sealLog' = Append(sealLog, c)
  /\ belt' = Tail(belt)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<offBelt, broken>>

\* A car that was already sealed and re-enters the head is diverted off the belt
Divert(c) ==
  /\ Len(belt) > 0
  /\ Head(belt) = c
  /\ c \in Range(sealLog)
  /\ belt' = Tail(belt)
  /\ offBelt' = offBelt \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sealLog, broken>>

\* A bay breaks down and stops applying the seal coat
Breakdown(b) ==
  /\ b \notin broken
  /\ broken' = broken \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<belt, sealLog, offBelt>>

\* A bay is repaired and resumes service
Repair(b) ==
  /\ b \in broken
  /\ broken' = broken \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<belt, sealLog, offBelt>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Mount(c)
  \/ \E b \in Bays, c \in Cars : Seal(b, c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Divert(c)
  \/ \E b \in Bays : Breakdown(b)
  \/ \E b \in Bays : Repair(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The seal log never records the same car twice: no repeated irreversible seal
SealOnce ==
  Cardinality(Range(sealLog)) = Len(sealLog)
====
nl: A car-wash conveyor line moves cars along a bounded belt toward a seal-coat station. A car mounts the belt only while the belt has room, and never if it is already on the belt or has already been sealed; a full belt applies backpressure. A working bay applies the irreversible seal coat to the car at the head of the belt, but only if that car has never been sealed before, recording the application in the seal log. A car that was already sealed and re-enters the head is diverted off the belt instead of being sealed again. A bay may break down and stop applying the seal coat, and later be repaired to resume service. SAFETY PROPERTY: the seal log never records the same car twice, so the irreversible seal coat is applied to each car at most once.

EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Instances, Courses

VARIABLES
  primary,     \* the instance actually holding primary authority
  term,        \* failover term (advances when authority moves)
  committing,  \* [Instances -> Courses \cup {"none"}] enrollment each instance is committing
  enrolled     \* set of courses whose enrollment has committed

vars == <<primary, term, committing, enrolled>>

NoC     == "none"
MaxTerm == 2
AllIdle == \A i \in Instances : committing[i] = NoC

TypeOK ==
  /\ primary \in Instances
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ committing \in [Instances -> Courses \cup {NoC}]
  /\ enrolled \subseteq Courses

Init ==
  /\ primary = CHOOSE i \in Instances : TRUE
  /\ term = 0
  /\ committing = [i \in Instances |-> NoC]
  /\ enrolled = {}

\* Authority fails over to another instance, but only during a quiescent window
Failover(i) ==
  /\ i # primary
  /\ term < MaxTerm
  /\ AllIdle
  /\ primary' = i
  /\ term' = term + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<committing, enrolled>>

\* Only the true primary may start committing an enrollment for a course
StartCommit(i, c) ==
  /\ i = primary
  /\ committing[i] = NoC
  /\ c \notin enrolled
  /\ committing' = [committing EXCEPT ![i] = c]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<primary, term, enrolled>>

\* The in-flight enrollment is finalized into the shared enrolled pool
FinishCommit(i) ==
  /\ committing[i] # NoC
  /\ enrolled' = enrolled \cup {committing[i]}
  /\ committing' = [committing EXCEPT ![i] = NoC]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<primary, term>>

\* An enrolled course is dropped, freeing it to be committed again
Drop(c) ==
  /\ c \in enrolled
  /\ enrolled' = enrolled \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<primary, term, committing>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instances : Failover(i)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, c \in Courses : StartCommit(i, c)
  \/ \E i \in Instances : FinishCommit(i)
  \/ \E c \in Courses : Drop(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No instance ever commits an enrollment unless it is the true primary
NoStalePrimary ==
  \A i \in Instances : committing[i] # NoC => i = primary
====

Authority may fail over to the other instance, advancing the failover term, but only during a quiescent window when no instance is mid-commit. Only the instance that actually holds primary authority may start committing an enrollment for a not-yet-enrolled course; that in-flight enrollment is then finalized into the shared enrolled pool. An enrolled course may be dropped, freeing it to be committed again. SAFETY PROPERTY: no instance ever commits an enrollment unless it is the true primary.

---- MODULE W4Od4m3p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, Commands

VARIABLES
  leader,   \* the node currently elected controller, or "none"
  term,     \* current leadership term (advances on each election)
  issued,   \* set of <<command, node, term>> control commands accepted for execution
  applied   \* set of commands that have been applied (in any order, messages reorder)

vars == <<leader, term, issued, applied>>

None    == "none"
MaxTerm == 2

TypeOK ==
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ issued \subseteq (Commands \X Nodes \X (0..MaxTerm))
  /\ applied \subseteq Commands

Init ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ term = 0
  /\ issued = {}
  /\ applied = {}

\* A new controller is elected; a fresh term invalidates and clears prior commands
Elect(n) ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE MaxTerm
  /\ issued' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED applied

\* The current controller crashes, leaving the line without a leader
StepDown ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ issued' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, applied>>

\* Only the current controller, tagged with the current term, may issue a command
Issue(c, n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ <<c, n, term>> \notin issued
  /\ issued' = issued \cup {<<c, n, term>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, applied>>

\* An accepted command is applied; reordered arrival means any accepted one may apply
Apply(c, n) ==
  /\ <<c, n, term>> \in issued
  /\ c \notin applied
  /\ applied' = applied \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, issued>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
  \/ StepDown
  \/ \E c \in Commands, n \in Nodes : Issue(c, n)
  \/ \E c \in Commands, n \in Nodes : Apply(c, n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every accepted command was issued by the current leader under the current term
NoStaleCommand ==
  \A c \in Commands, n \in Nodes, t \in 0..MaxTerm :
    <<c, n, t>> \in issued => (n = leader /\ t = term)
====
nl: A car-wash conveyor line is driven by a controller elected among nodes via leader election with failover. Electing a new controller advances the leadership term and clears all prior control commands, since a fresh term invalidates them. The current controller may crash and step down, leaving the line leaderless. Only the current controller, tagged with the current term, may issue a control command; commands accumulate as an unordered set because messages can be reordered. An accepted command is later applied, and reordered arrival means any accepted command may be applied in any order. SAFETY PROPERTY: every accepted control command was issued by the current leader under the current term.

---- MODULE W4Od14m6p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Zones, Drones

VARIABLES
  owner,    \* [Zones -> Drones \cup {"free"}] drone holding each zone's lease
  expiry,   \* [Zones -> Nat] logical time at which each zone's lease expires
  clock,    \* current logical clock
  serving,  \* [Zones -> Drones \cup {"none"}] drone currently servicing each zone
  crashed   \* set of drones that have crashed silently

vars == <<owner, expiry, clock, serving, crashed>>

Free    == "free"
NoD     == "none"
MaxTime == 3
LeaseK  == 2

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in [Zones -> Drones \cup {Free}]
  /\ expiry \in [Zones -> 0..MaxTime]
  /\ clock \in 0..MaxTime
  /\ serving \in [Zones -> Drones \cup {NoD}]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Drones

Init ==
  /\ owner = [z \in Zones |-> Free]
  /\ expiry = [z \in Zones |-> 0]
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ serving = [z \in Zones |-> NoD]
  /\ crashed = {}

\* A live drone is granted a lease on a free zone, expiring LeaseK ticks from now
Grant(z, d) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ owner[z] = Free
  /\ clock + LeaseK <= MaxTime
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![z] = d]
  /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![z] = clock + LeaseK]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, serving, crashed>>

\* Only the lease-holder, while its lease is unexpired, may service the zone
StartService(z, d) ==
  /\ owner[z] = d
  /\ expiry[z] > clock
  /\ serving[z] = NoD
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![z] = d]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, clock, crashed>>

\* A drone stops servicing a zone
StopService(z) ==
  /\ serving[z] # NoD
  /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![z] = NoD]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, clock, crashed>>

\* Time advances, but never past the expiry of a zone still being serviced
Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxTime
  /\ \A z \in Zones : serving[z] = NoD \/ expiry[z] > clock + 1
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, serving, crashed>>

\* A drone crashes silently and abandons any zone it was servicing
Crash(d) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {d}
  /\ serving' = [z \in Zones |-> IF serving[z] = d THEN NoD ELSE serving[z]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, clock>>

\* A crashed drone is recovered and rejoins the swarm
Recover(d) ==
  /\ d \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, clock, serving>>

Next ==
  \/ \E z \in Zones, d \in Drones : Grant(z, d)
  \/ \E z \in Zones, d \in Drones : StartService(z, d)
  \/ \E z \in Zones : StopService(z)
  \/ Tick
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Crash(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Recover(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A zone is serviced only by the holder of an unexpired lease on that zone
NoStaleService ==
  \A z \in Zones :
    serving[z] # NoD => (owner[z] = serving[z] /\ expiry[z] > clock)
====
nl: A wildfire drone surveillance swarm assigns zones to drones using lease-based ownership with expiry against a logical clock. A live drone is granted a lease on a free zone that expires a fixed number of ticks in the future. Only the drone holding a zone's lease, and only while that lease is unexpired, may begin servicing the zone; it may later stop servicing. Time advances one tick at a time, but never past the expiry of a lease on a zone that is still being serviced. A drone may crash silently and abandon any zone it was servicing. SAFETY PROPERTY: a zone is serviced only by the holder of an unexpired lease on that zone.

---- MODULE W4Od11m8p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Printers, Clients

VARIABLES
  buffer,     \* sheets waiting in the shared input buffer
  loaded,     \* [Printers -> Nat] sheets loaded into each printer's tray
  printed,    \* sheets that have been printed and delivered
  spoolLock,  \* holder of the coarse spooler lock, or "free"
  trayLock,   \* [Printers -> Clients \cup {"free"}] fine per-printer tray lock
  capacity    \* number of printer trays currently enabled (changes at runtime)

vars == <<buffer, loaded, printed, spoolLock, trayLock, capacity>>

Free  == "free"
Total == 3
MaxCap == 2

Sum(f, S) == LET g[T \in SUBSET S] ==
                  IF T = {} THEN 0
                  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in T : TRUE
                       IN f[x] + g[T \ {x}]
             IN g[S]

TypeOK ==
  /\ buffer \in 0..Total
  /\ loaded \in [Printers -> 0..Total]
  /\ printed \in 0..Total
  /\ spoolLock \in Clients \cup {Free}
  /\ trayLock \in [Printers -> Clients \cup {Free}]
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ buffer = Total
  /\ loaded = [p \in Printers |-> 0]
  /\ printed = 0
  /\ spoolLock = Free
  /\ trayLock = [p \in Printers |-> Free]
  /\ capacity = 2

\* Acquire the coarse spooler lock (hierarchical: coarse before fine)
AcquireSpool(c) ==
  /\ spoolLock = Free
  /\ spoolLock' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<buffer, loaded, printed, trayLock, capacity>>

\* Holding the spooler lock, acquire a fine tray lock while capacity remains
AcquireTray(c, p) ==
  /\ spoolLock = c
  /\ trayLock[p] = Free
  /\ capacity > 0
  /\ trayLock' = [trayLock EXCEPT ![p] = c]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<buffer, loaded, printed, spoolLock, capacity>>

\* With both locks, move one sheet from the shared buffer into a printer tray
LoadSheet(c, p) ==
  /\ spoolLock = c
  /\ trayLock[p] = c
  /\ buffer > 0
  /\ buffer' = buffer - 1
  /\ loaded' = [loaded EXCEPT ![p] = @ + 1]
  /\ trayLock' = [trayLock EXCEPT ![p] = Free]
  /\ spoolLock' = Free
  /\ UNCHANGED <<printed, capacity>>

\* A printer prints one loaded sheet and delivers it
Print(p) ==
  /\ loaded[p] > 0
  /\ loaded' = [loaded EXCEPT ![p] = @ - 1]
  /\ printed' = printed + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<buffer, spoolLock, trayLock, capacity>>

\* A delivered sheet is recycled back into the shared buffer as scrap stock
Recycle ==
  /\ printed > 0
  /\ printed' = printed - 1
  /\ buffer' = buffer + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<loaded, spoolLock, trayLock, capacity>>

\* Tray capacity is adjusted at runtime as trays are enabled or disabled
Rescale(k) ==
  /\ k \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ k # capacity
  /\ capacity' = k
  /\ UNCHANGED <<buffer, loaded, printed, spoolLock, trayLock>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Clients : AcquireSpool(c)
  \/ \E c \in Clients, p \in Printers : AcquireTray(c, p)
  \/ \E c \in Clients, p \in Printers : LoadSheet(c, p)
  \/ \E p \in Printers : Print(p)
  \/ Recycle
  \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCap : Rescale(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The total number of sheets is conserved across buffer, trays, and delivered output
Conservation ==
  buffer + Sum(loaded, Printers) + printed = Total
====
nl: A print shop job spooler feeds sheets from a shared input buffer to printers under hierarchical locks: a client first acquires the coarse spooler lock, then a fine per-printer tray lock, and only as many trays as the current capacity allows can be locked at once. Holding both locks, one sheet moves from the shared buffer into a printer tray, releasing both locks. A printer prints one loaded sheet and delivers it, and a delivered sheet may be recycled back into the shared buffer as scrap stock. Tray capacity is adjusted at runtime as trays are enabled or disabled. Sheets only ever move between the buffer, the trays, and the delivered output; none are created or destroyed. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of sheets across the input buffer, all printer trays, and delivered output is always conserved and equal to the initial total.

  printed,  \* set of <<slot, job>> jobs that finished printing

  /\ grants' = grants \cup {<<s, j, clock + LeaseK>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, printed, crashed>>

\* The lease-holder prints on its slot while the lease is still valid
DoPrint(s, j, e) ==
  /\ <<s, j, e>> \in grants
  /\ e > clock
  /\ printed' = printed \cup {<<s, j>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, clock, crashed>>

\* An expired lease is reclaimed, freeing the slot
Expire(s, j, e) ==
  /\ <<s, j, e>> \in grants
  /\ e <= clock
  /\ grants' = grants \ {<<s, j, e>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, printed, crashed>>

\* Time advances one tick
Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxTime
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, printed, crashed>>

\* A job's client crashes silently, dropping all of that job's leases
Crash(j) ==
  /\ j \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {j}
  /\ grants' = { g \in grants : JobOf(g) # j }
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, printed>>

\* A job's client is restarted and rejoins
Recover(j) ==
  /\ j \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, clock, printed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Slots, j \in Jobs : Lease(s, j)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, j \in Jobs, e \in 0..MaxTime : DoPrint(s, j, e)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, j \in Jobs, e \in 0..MaxTime : Expire(s, j, e)
  \/ Tick
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Crash(j)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Recover(j)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No print slot is ever leased to two different jobs at the same time
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A x, y \in grants : (SlotOf(x) = SlotOf(y)) => (JobOf(x) = JobOf(y))
====
nl: A print shop job spooler assigns print slots to jobs using lease-based ownership with expiry against a logical clock. A live job may lease a currently-unleased print slot, holding it until a fixed number of ticks in the future. The lease-holder prints on its slot only while the lease is still valid. An expired lease is reclaimed, freeing the slot for another job. Time advances one tick at a time. A job's client may crash silently, dropping all of that job's leases. Because a slot can only be leased while it is unleased, it is never held by two jobs at once. SAFETY PROPERTY: no print slot is ever leased to two different jobs at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od18m5p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, Sequences

CONSTANTS Nodes, Writers

VARIABLES
  commits,   \* Seq of <<writer, basedOn>>: each committed update and the version it read
  readVer,   \* [Writers -> Nat] version each writer read while preparing
  prepared,  \* set of writers currently prepared to commit
  votes      \* set of <<writer, node>> quorum approvals for prepared writers

vars == <<commits, readVer, prepared, votes>>

Quorum  == 2
MaxCommits == 3
Version == Len(commits)
VotersOf(w) == { n \in Nodes : <<w, n>> \in votes }

TypeOK ==
  /\ commits \in Seq(Writers \X (0..MaxCommits))
  /\ readVer \in [Writers -> 0..MaxCommits]
  /\ prepared \subseteq Writers
  /\ votes \subseteq (Writers \X Nodes)

Init ==
  /\ commits = << >>
  /\ readVer = [w \in Writers |-> 0]
  /\ prepared = {}
  /\ votes = {}

\* A writer prepares by reading the current version of the shared record
Prepare(w) ==
  /\ w \notin prepared
  /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![w] = Version]
  /\ prepared' = prepared \cup {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<commits, votes>>

\* A node approves a prepared writer's update
Approve(w, n) ==
  /\ w \in prepared
  /\ <<w, n>> \notin votes
  /\ votes' = votes \cup {<<w, n>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<commits, readVer, prepared>>

\* Commit succeeds only if a quorum approved and the version read is still current
Commit(w) ==
  /\ w \in prepared
  /\ Cardinality(VotersOf(w)) >= Quorum
  /\ readVer[w] = Version
  /\ Len(commits) < MaxCommits
  /\ commits' = Append(commits, <<w, readVer[w]>>)
  /\ prepared' = prepared \ {w}
  /\ votes' = { v \in votes : v[1] # w }
  /\ UNCHANGED readVer

\* A prepared writer abandons its attempt, discarding its votes
Abort(w) ==
  /\ w \in prepared
  /\ prepared' = prepared \ {w}
  /\ votes' = { v \in votes : v[1] # w }
  /\ UNCHANGED <<commits, readVer>>

Next ==
  \/ \E w \in Writers : Prepare(w)
  \/ \E w \in Writers, n \in Nodes : Approve(w, n)
  \/ \E w \in Writers : Commit(w)
  \/ \E w \in Writers : Abort(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Each committed update was based on the version left by its immediate predecessor,
\* so no concurrent update was ever silently overwritten
NoLostUpdate ==
  \A k \in 1..Len(commits) : commits[k][2] = k - 1
====
nl: A smart-home door lock network maintains one shared configuration record written by two independent controller instances, where every update is approved by quorum voting among nodes. A writer prepares by reading the current version of the shared record. A node approves a prepared writer's update, and a prepared writer commits only once a quorum has approved and the version it read is still the current version, appending its update and recording the version it was based on. A prepared writer may abandon its attempt, discarding its votes. Because a commit is rejected when the version has moved on since the writer read it, no concurrent update is ever silently overwritten. SAFETY PROPERTY: each committed update was based on the version left by its immediate predecessor, so no update is ever lost.

CONSTANTS Surgeons, Rooms

VARIABLES
  booking,   \* [Surgeons -> Rooms \cup {"none"}] confirmed room per surgeon
  tentative, \* [Surgeons -> Rooms \cup {"none"}] tentative hold per surgeon
  holdEpoch, \* [Surgeons -> Nat] epoch at which the tentative hold was taken
  epoch      \* current configuration epoch

vars == <<booking, tentative, holdEpoch, epoch>>

NoR      == "none"
MaxEpoch == 2
RoomBooked(r) == \E s \in Surgeons : booking[s] = r
RoomHeld(r)   == \E s \in Surgeons : tentative[s] = r

TypeOK ==
  /\ booking \in [Surgeons -> Rooms \cup {NoR}]
  /\ tentative \in [Surgeons -> Rooms \cup {NoR}]
  /\ holdEpoch \in [Surgeons -> 0..MaxEpoch]
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch

  /\ booking = [s \in Surgeons |-> NoR]
  /\ tentative = [s \in Surgeons |-> NoR]
  /\ holdEpoch = [s \in Surgeons |-> 0]
  /\ epoch = 0

\* A surgeon takes a tentative hold on a room free of holds and bookings
Hold(s, r) ==
  /\ tentative[s] = NoR
  /\ booking[s] = NoR
  /\ ~RoomHeld(r)
  /\ ~RoomBooked(r)
  /\ tentative' = [tentative EXCEPT ![s] = r]
  /\ holdEpoch' = [holdEpoch EXCEPT ![s] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<booking, epoch>>

\* A surgeon (possibly slow, but not failed) confirms its hold, if still current and
\* the room has not since been booked by anyone else
Confirm(s) ==
  /\ tentative[s] # NoR
  /\ holdEpoch[s] = epoch
  /\ ~RoomBooked(tentative[s])
  /\ booking' = [booking EXCEPT ![s] = tentative[s]]
  /\ tentative' = [tentative EXCEPT ![s] = NoR]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holdEpoch, epoch>>

\* A tentative hold is dropped
DropHold(s) ==
  /\ tentative[s] # NoR
  /\ tentative' = [tentative EXCEPT ![s] = NoR]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<booking, holdEpoch, epoch>>

\* A confirmed booking is released after the operation
ReleaseBooking(s) ==
  /\ booking[s] # NoR
  /\ booking' = [booking EXCEPT ![s] = NoR]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tentative, holdEpoch, epoch>>

\* Reconfiguration advances the epoch, staling all outstanding tentative holds
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<booking, tentative, holdEpoch>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Surgeons, r \in Rooms : Hold(s, r)
  \/ \E s \in Surgeons : Confirm(s)
  \/ \E s \in Surgeons : DropHold(s)
  \/ \E s \in Surgeons : ReleaseBooking(s)
  \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No room is ever confirmed to two different surgeons: bookings are injective on rooms
NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A s1, s2 \in Surgeons :
    (booking[s1] # NoR /\ booking[s1] = booking[s2]) => s1 = s2
====
nl: A hospital operating-room scheduler assigns rooms to surgeons under an epoch-numbered configuration, using a two-step tentative-then-confirm booking. A surgeon takes a tentative hold on a room that is free of both holds and confirmed bookings, tagging the hold with the current epoch. A surgeon may be slow but does not fail; it later confirms its hold into a booking, but only if the hold is still current for the epoch and the room has not since been booked by anyone else. A tentative hold may be dropped, and a confirmed booking is released after the operation. Reconfiguration advances the epoch, staling all outstanding tentative holds so they can no longer be confirmed. SAFETY PROPERTY: no room is ever confirmed to two different surgeons at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od6m1p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cars, Floors

VARIABLES
  token,       \* the car currently holding the ring token
  serving,     \* [Cars -> Floors \cup {"none"}] floor each car is currently serving
  requests,    \* set of floors with a pending call
  adminGrant   \* set of cars granted a privileged admin override

vars == <<token, serving, requests, adminGrant>>

NoF == "none"

\* Fixed ring order over the cars (numbered 0..N-1)
NextCar(c) == IF c = 2 THEN 0 ELSE c + 1

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in Cars
  /\ serving \in [Cars -> Floors \cup {NoF}]
  /\ requests \subseteq Floors
  /\ adminGrant \subseteq Cars

Init ==
  /\ token = 0
  /\ serving = [c \in Cars |-> NoF]
  /\ requests = Floors
  /\ adminGrant = {}

\* A call button is pressed for a floor
Press(f) ==
  /\ f \notin requests
  /\ requests' = requests \cup {f}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, serving, adminGrant>>

\* Only the token-holder or a car with admin override may start serving a call
Serve(c, f) ==
  /\ token = c \/ c \in adminGrant
  /\ serving[c] = NoF
  /\ f \in requests
  /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![c] = f]
  /\ requests' = requests \ {f}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, adminGrant>>

\* A car finishes serving its floor
Complete(c) ==
  /\ serving[c] # NoF
  /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![c] = NoF]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, requests, adminGrant>>

\* The token is passed to the next car in the ring, only while its holder is idle
PassToken ==
  /\ serving[token] = NoF
  /\ token' = NextCar(token)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<serving, requests, adminGrant>>

\* The building admin grants a privileged override to an idle car
GrantOverride(c) ==
  /\ c \notin adminGrant
  /\ adminGrant' = adminGrant \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, serving, requests>>

\* The admin revokes an override from an idle car
RevokeOverride(c) ==
  /\ c \in adminGrant
  /\ serving[c] = NoF
  /\ adminGrant' = adminGrant \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, serving, requests>>

Next ==
  \/ \E f \in Floors : Press(f)
  \/ \E c \in Cars, f \in Floors : Serve(c, f)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Complete(c)
  \/ PassToken
  \/ \E c \in Cars : GrantOverride(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : RevokeOverride(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A car serves a floor only if it holds the ring token or has an admin override
NoUnauthorizedService ==
  \A c \in Cars : serving[c] # NoF => (token = c \/ c \in adminGrant)
====
nl: An elevator bank in a skyscraper coordinates its cars with a token ring: a single token circulates in a fixed ring order, and only the current token-holder may act, except that a car granted a privileged admin override may also act. A call button may be pressed for a floor. Only the token-holder or a car with an admin override may start serving a pending call, and it finishes serving before going idle. The token is passed to the next car in the ring only while its current holder is idle. The building admin may grant a privileged override to an idle car and may revoke an override from an idle car. SAFETY PROPERTY: a car serves a floor only if it holds the ring token or has been granted an admin override.

---- MODULE W4Od15m2p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Participants, Authorized, Orders

VARIABLES
  txn,        \* the order currently under two-phase commit, or "none"
  vote,       \* [Participants -> {"none","yes","no"}] prepare votes (arrive reordered)
  session,    \* current trading session epoch
  partSess,   \* [Participants -> Nat] session each participant is credentialed for
  committed   \* set of orders that have committed

vars == <<txn, vote, session, partSess, committed>>

NoTxn   == "none"
MaxSess == 2

TypeOK ==
  /\ txn \in Orders \cup {NoTxn}
  /\ vote \in [Participants -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
  /\ session \in 0..MaxSess
  /\ partSess \in [Participants -> 0..MaxSess]
  /\ committed \subseteq Orders

Init ==
  /\ txn = NoTxn
  /\ vote = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ session = 0
  /\ partSess = [p \in Participants |-> 0]
  /\ committed = {}

\* The coordinator opens a two-phase commit for an order
StartTxn(o) ==
  /\ txn = NoTxn
  /\ o \notin committed
  /\ txn' = o
  /\ vote' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<session, partSess, committed>>

\* Only an authorized participant credentialed for the current session may vote;
\* votes may be recorded in any order
Vote(p, v) ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ p \in Authorized
  /\ partSess[p] = session
  /\ vote[p] = "none"
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![p] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, session, partSess, committed>>

\* Commit when every authorized participant has voted yes
Commit ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ \A p \in Authorized : vote[p] = "yes"
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {txn}
  /\ txn' = NoTxn
  /\ vote' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<session, partSess>>

\* Abort if any authorized participant voted no
Abort ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ \E p \in Authorized : vote[p] = "no"
  /\ txn' = NoTxn
  /\ vote' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<session, partSess, committed>>

\* Rotating the trading session revokes stale credentials and clears pending votes
Rotate ==
  /\ session < MaxSess
  /\ session' = session + 1
  /\ vote' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ txn' = NoTxn
  /\ UNCHANGED <<partSess, committed>>

\* An authorized participant renews its credential to the current session
Renew(p) ==
  /\ p \in Authorized
  /\ partSess[p] # session
  /\ partSess' = [partSess EXCEPT ![p] = session]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, vote, session, committed>>

\* A committed order is cleared off the book once settled, freeing it to trade again
Unlist(o) ==
  /\ o \in committed
  /\ committed' = committed \ {o}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, vote, session, partSess>>

Next ==
  \/ \E o \in Orders : StartTxn(o)
  \/ \E p \in Participants, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(p, v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ Rotate
  \/ \E p \in Participants : Renew(p)
  \/ \E o \in Orders : Unlist(o)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every recorded prepare vote is from an authorized participant credentialed
\* for the current session
NoStaleVote ==
  \A p \in Participants :
    vote[p] # "none" => (p \in Authorized /\ partSess[p] = session)
====
nl: A stock exchange opening auction settles each matched order via two-phase commit across participants, where only participants credentialed for the current trading session are authorized. The coordinator opens a two-phase commit for an order. Only an authorized participant credentialed for the current session may cast a prepare vote, and because messages can be reordered, votes may be recorded in any order. The order commits when every authorized participant has voted yes, and aborts if any authorized participant voted no. Rotating the trading session revokes stale credentials and clears all pending votes, and an authorized participant may renew its credential to the current session. SAFETY PROPERTY: every recorded prepare vote is from an authorized participant credentialed for the current session.

---- MODULE W4Od3m5p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks, Voters

VARIABLES
  balance,   \* [Banks -> Nat] settled funds held at each bank
  escrow,    \* funds moved into escrow for the in-flight settlement
  proposal,  \* the <<from, to>> transfer under settlement, or "none"
  approvals, \* set of voters who approved the in-flight settlement
  capacity   \* settlement-window capacity (changes at runtime)

vars == <<balance, escrow, proposal, approvals, capacity>>

NoProp  == "none"
Quorum  == 2
Total   == 3
MaxCap  == 2

Seed == CHOOSE b \in Banks : TRUE

Sum(f, S) == LET g[T \in SUBSET S] ==
                  IF T = {} THEN 0
                  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in T : TRUE
                       IN f[x] + g[T \ {x}]
             IN g[S]

TypeOK ==
  /\ balance \in [Banks -> 0..Total]
  /\ escrow \in 0..Total
  /\ proposal \in (Banks \X Banks) \cup {NoProp}
  /\ approvals \subseteq Voters
  /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ balance = [b \in Banks |-> IF b = Seed THEN Total ELSE 0]
  /\ escrow = 0
  /\ proposal = NoProp
  /\ approvals = {}
  /\ capacity = 2

\* Propose a transfer, moving one unit from the sender into escrow, consuming capacity
Propose(a, b) ==
  /\ proposal = NoProp
  /\ a # b
  /\ balance[a] > 0
  /\ capacity > 0
  /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![a] = @ - 1]
  /\ escrow' = escrow + 1
  /\ proposal' = <<a, b>>
  /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED approvals

\* A voter approves the in-flight settlement
Approve(v) ==
  /\ proposal # NoProp
  /\ v \notin approvals
  /\ approvals' = approvals \cup {v}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, escrow, proposal, capacity>>

\* Settle once a quorum approves, releasing escrow to the receiver
Settle ==
  /\ proposal # NoProp
  /\ Cardinality(approvals) >= Quorum
  /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![proposal[2]] = @ + 1]
  /\ escrow' = escrow - 1
  /\ proposal' = NoProp
  /\ approvals' = {}
  /\ capacity' = capacity + 1

\* Cancel the settlement, refunding escrow to the sender
Cancel ==
  /\ proposal # NoProp
  /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![proposal[1]] = @ + 1]
  /\ escrow' = escrow - 1
  /\ proposal' = NoProp
  /\ approvals' = {}
  /\ capacity' = capacity + 1

\* Adjust the settlement-window capacity at runtime
Rescale(k) ==
  /\ k \in 0..MaxCap
  /\ k # capacity
  /\ capacity' = k
  /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, escrow, proposal, approvals>>

Next ==
  \/ \E a \in Banks, b \in Banks : Propose(a, b)
  \/ \E v \in Voters : Approve(v)
  \/ Settle
  \/ Cancel
  \/ \E k \in 0..MaxCap : Rescale(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Total funds are conserved across all bank balances and escrow
Conservation ==
  Sum(balance, Banks) + escrow = Total
====
nl: A bank's interbank settlement batch moves funds between banks, with each settlement approved by quorum voting among voters. A transfer is proposed by moving one unit from the sender's balance into escrow, which consumes one unit of the settlement-window capacity. Voters approve the in-flight settlement, and once a quorum has approved, the settlement releases the escrowed unit to the receiver and returns the capacity. A settlement may instead be cancelled, refunding the escrowed unit to the sender and returning the capacity. The settlement-window capacity is adjusted at runtime. Funds only ever move between bank balances and escrow; none are created or destroyed. SAFETY PROPERTY: the total funds across all bank balances and escrow is always conserved and equal to the initial total.

---- MODULE W4Od12m9p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Tokens, Writers

VARIABLES
  content,       \* the shared inventory record: set of applied update tokens
  everCommitted, \* audit set of every token ever committed to the record
  staged,        \* set of writers currently holding a live snapshot
  snapshot,      \* [Writers -> SUBSET Tokens] snapshot each staged writer read
  epoch          \* current record-layout epoch

vars == <<content, everCommitted, staged, snapshot, epoch>>

MaxEpoch == 2

TypeOK ==
  /\ content \subseteq Tokens
  /\ everCommitted \subseteq Tokens
  /\ staged \subseteq Writers
  /\ snapshot \in [Writers -> SUBSET Tokens]
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch

Init ==
  /\ content = {}
  /\ everCommitted = {}
  /\ staged = {}
  /\ snapshot = [w \in Writers |-> {}]
  /\ epoch = 0

\* A writer reads a snapshot of the current record
Stage(w) ==
  /\ w \notin staged
  /\ staged' = staged \cup {w}
  /\ snapshot' = [snapshot EXCEPT ![w] = content]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<content, everCommitted, epoch>>

\* A (possibly slow) writer commits only if its snapshot is still current, writing back
\* the snapshot plus its new token via compare-and-set
Commit(w, tok) ==
  /\ w \in staged
  /\ snapshot[w] = content
  /\ tok \notin content
  /\ content' = snapshot[w] \cup {tok}
  /\ everCommitted' = everCommitted \cup {tok}
  /\ staged' = staged \ {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<snapshot, epoch>>

\* A writer whose snapshot has gone stale abandons and will re-read
Abort(w) ==
  /\ w \in staged
  /\ staged' = staged \ {w}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<content, everCommitted, snapshot, epoch>>

\* Reconfiguration advances the record-layout epoch and invalidates staged snapshots
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ staged' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<content, everCommitted, snapshot>>

Next ==
  \/ \E w \in Writers : Stage(w)
  \/ \E w \in Writers, tok \in Tokens : Commit(w, tok)
  \/ \E w \in Writers : Abort(w)
  \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every token ever committed remains present in the record: no update is lost
NoLostUpdate ==
  everCommitted \subseteq content
====
nl: A blood-bank inventory tracker maintains one shared record, modelled as the set of applied update tokens, written concurrently by two writers under an epoch-numbered record layout. A writer reads a snapshot of the current record. A writer may be slow but does not fail; it commits its update only if its snapshot is still current, writing back the snapshot plus its new token via compare-and-set. A writer whose snapshot has gone stale abandons its attempt and will re-read. Reconfiguration advances the record-layout epoch and invalidates all staged snapshots. Because a commit is rejected when the record has changed since the writer read it, no previously committed token is ever overwritten and lost. SAFETY PROPERTY: every token ever committed remains present in the shared record, so no update is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od12m7p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Fridges, Techs

VARIABLES
  reg,      \* [Fridges -> Techs \cup {"free"}] compare-and-swap lock register per fridge
  inCS,     \* [Techs -> Fridges \cup {"none"}] fridge a tech is currently accessing
  pending,  \* set of <<fridge, tech>> access requests (may arrive reordered)
  served    \* set of <<fridge, tech>> completed accesses

vars == <<reg, inCS, pending, served>>

Free == "free"
NoF  == "none"

TypeOK ==
  /\ reg \in [Fridges -> Techs \cup {Free}]
  /\ inCS \in [Techs -> Fridges \cup {NoF}]
  /\ pending \subseteq (Fridges \X Techs)
  /\ served \subseteq (Fridges \X Techs)

Init ==
  /\ reg = [f \in Fridges |-> Free]
  /\ inCS = [t \in Techs |-> NoF]
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ served = {}

\* An access request is submitted; requests may pile up and be handled in any order
Request(f, t) ==
  /\ <<f, t>> \notin pending
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {<<f, t>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, inCS, served>>

\* Compare-and-swap: a tech enters a fridge only by swapping its lock from free to itself
Acquire(f, t) ==
  /\ <<f, t>> \in pending
  /\ reg[f] = Free
  /\ inCS[t] = NoF
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![f] = t]
  /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![t] = f]
  /\ pending' = pending \ {<<f, t>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED served

\* A tech leaves the fridge and swaps its lock back to free
Release(f, t) ==
  /\ reg[f] = t
  /\ inCS[t] = f
  /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![f] = Free]
  /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![t] = NoF]
  /\ served' = served \cup {<<f, t>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED pending

\* A reordered or superseded request is dropped from the pending set
Cancel(f, t) ==
  /\ <<f, t>> \in pending
  /\ pending' = pending \ {<<f, t>>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, inCS, served>>

Next ==
  \/ \E f \in Fridges, t \in Techs : Request(f, t)
  \/ \E f \in Fridges, t \in Techs : Acquire(f, t)
  \/ \E f \in Fridges, t \in Techs : Release(f, t)
  \/ \E f \in Fridges, t \in Techs : Cancel(f, t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A tech occupies a fridge only while it holds that fridge's compare-and-swap lock
Mutex ==
  \A t \in Techs : inCS[t] # NoF => reg[inCS[t]] = t
====
nl: A blood-bank inventory tracker guards exclusive access to refrigerated fridges using a compare-and-swap lock register, one register per fridge. An access request is submitted by a technician; because messages can be reordered, requests may pile up and be handled in any order. A technician enters a fridge only by a compare-and-swap that succeeds when the fridge's lock is free, swapping it from free to that technician, and no technician may occupy two fridges at once. A technician leaves the fridge by swapping its lock back to free. A reordered or superseded request may be dropped from the pending set. SAFETY PROPERTY: a technician occupies a fridge only while it holds that fridge's compare-and-swap lock, so no two technicians ever share a fridge.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m2p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Dispensers, Clients, Participants

VARIABLES
  lock,   \* [Dispensers -> Clients \cup {"free"}] exclusive holder of each dispenser
  inCS,   \* [Clients -> Dispensers \cup {"none"}] dispenser a client is currently using
  txn,    \* the <<dispenser, client>> grant under two-phase commit, or "none"
  vote    \* [Participants -> {"none","yes","no"}] prepare votes (recorded in any order)

vars == <<lock, inCS, txn, vote>>

Free  == "free"
NoD   == "none"
NoTxn == "none"

TypeOK ==
  /\ lock \in [Dispensers -> Clients \cup {Free}]
  /\ inCS \in [Clients -> Dispensers \cup {NoD}]
  /\ txn \in (Dispensers \X Clients) \cup {NoTxn}
  /\ vote \in [Participants -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]

Init ==
  /\ lock = [d \in Dispensers |-> Free]
  /\ inCS = [c \in Clients |-> NoD]
  /\ txn = NoTxn
  /\ vote = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]

\* Open a two-phase commit granting exclusive use of a free dispenser to a client
Propose(d, c) ==
  /\ txn = NoTxn
  /\ lock[d] = Free
  /\ inCS[c] = NoD
  /\ txn' = <<d, c>>
  /\ vote' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, inCS>>

\* A participant casts its prepare vote; reordering means votes land in any order
CastVote(p, v) ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ vote[p] = "none"
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![p] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, inCS, txn>>

\* Commit the exclusive grant once every participant has voted yes and it is still free
Commit ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ \A p \in Participants : vote[p] = "yes"
  /\ lock[txn[1]] = Free
  /\ lock' = [lock EXCEPT ![txn[1]] = txn[2]]
  /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![txn[2]] = txn[1]]
  /\ txn' = NoTxn
  /\ vote' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]

\* Abort the grant if any participant voted no
Abort ==
  /\ txn # NoTxn
  /\ \E p \in Participants : vote[p] = "no"
  /\ txn' = NoTxn
  /\ vote' = [p \in Participants |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, inCS>>

\* A client finishes and releases its exclusive dispenser
Release(d, c) ==
  /\ lock[d] = c
  /\ inCS[c] = d
  /\ lock' = [lock EXCEPT ![d] = Free]
  /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![c] = NoD]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, vote>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Dispensers, c \in Clients : Propose(d, c)
  \/ \E p \in Participants, v \in {"yes", "no"} : CastVote(p, v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ \E d \in Dispensers, c \in Clients : Release(d, c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A client uses a dispenser only while it exclusively holds that dispenser's lock
Mutex ==
  \A c \in Clients : inCS[c] # NoD => lock[inCS[c]] = c
====
nl: A pharmacy prescription dispenser grants exclusive use of dispensers to clients via two-phase commit across participants. The coordinator opens a transaction granting a free dispenser to a client that is not already using one, resetting the prepare votes. Each participant casts a single yes or no prepare vote, and because messages can be reordered, votes may be recorded in any order. The grant commits only when every participant has voted yes and the dispenser is still free, giving the client exclusive access; it aborts if any participant voted no. A client finishes and releases its exclusive dispenser. SAFETY PROPERTY: a client uses a dispenser only while it exclusively holds that dispenser's lock, so no two clients ever share a dispenser.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m8p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Drawers, Pharmacists, Scripts

VARIABLES
  cabinet,      \* holder of the coarse cabinet lock, or "free"
  drawer,       \* [Drawers -> Pharmacists \cup {"free"}] fine per-drawer lock
  dispenseLog,  \* Seq recording each irreversible controlled-substance dispense
  crashed       \* set of pharmacists that have crashed silently

vars == <<cabinet, drawer, dispenseLog, crashed>>

Free     == "free"
Range(s) == { s[i] : i \in 1..Len(s) }

TypeOK ==
  /\ cabinet \in Pharmacists \cup {Free}
  /\ drawer \in [Drawers -> Pharmacists \cup {Free}]
  /\ dispenseLog \in Seq(Scripts)
  /\ crashed \subseteq Pharmacists

Init ==
  /\ cabinet = Free
  /\ drawer = [d \in Drawers |-> Free]
  /\ dispenseLog = << >>
  /\ crashed = {}

\* Acquire the coarse cabinet lock (hierarchical: cabinet before drawer)
AcquireCabinet(ph) ==
  /\ ph \notin crashed
  /\ cabinet = Free
  /\ cabinet' = ph
  /\ UNCHANGED <<drawer, dispenseLog, crashed>>

\* Holding the cabinet lock, acquire a fine drawer lock
AcquireDrawer(ph, d) ==
  /\ cabinet = ph
  /\ drawer[d] = Free
  /\ drawer' = [drawer EXCEPT ![d] = ph]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cabinet, dispenseLog, crashed>>

\* Holding both locks, irreversibly dispense a script that was never dispensed before
Dispense(ph, d, sc) ==
  /\ cabinet = ph
  /\ drawer[d] = ph
  /\ sc \notin Range(dispenseLog)
  /\ dispenseLog' = Append(dispenseLog, sc)
  /\ drawer' = [drawer EXCEPT ![d] = Free]
  /\ cabinet' = Free
  /\ UNCHANGED crashed

\* An already-dispensed script is skipped and the locks are released
Skip(ph, d, sc) ==
  /\ cabinet = ph
  /\ drawer[d] = ph
  /\ sc \in Range(dispenseLog)
  /\ drawer' = [drawer EXCEPT ![d] = Free]
  /\ cabinet' = Free
  /\ UNCHANGED <<dispenseLog, crashed>>

\* A pharmacist crashes silently, releasing any locks it held
Crash(ph) ==
  /\ ph \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {ph}
  /\ cabinet' = IF cabinet = ph THEN Free ELSE cabinet
  /\ drawer' = [d \in Drawers |-> IF drawer[d] = ph THEN Free ELSE drawer[d]]
  /\ UNCHANGED dispenseLog

\* A crashed pharmacist is relieved by a replacement and rejoins
Recover(ph) ==
  /\ ph \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {ph}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cabinet, drawer, dispenseLog>>

Next ==
  \/ \E ph \in Pharmacists : AcquireCabinet(ph)
  \/ \E ph \in Pharmacists, d \in Drawers : AcquireDrawer(ph, d)
  \/ \E ph \in Pharmacists, d \in Drawers, sc \in Scripts : Dispense(ph, d, sc)
  \/ \E ph \in Pharmacists, d \in Drawers, sc \in Scripts : Skip(ph, d, sc)
  \/ \E ph \in Pharmacists : Crash(ph)
  \/ \E ph \in Pharmacists : Recover(ph)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No controlled-substance script is ever dispensed twice: the log has no repeats
DispenseOnce ==
  \A i, j \in 1..Len(dispenseLog) : (dispenseLog[i] = dispenseLog[j]) => (i = j)
====
nl: A pharmacy prescription dispenser controls access to controlled substances with hierarchical locks: a pharmacist first acquires the coarse cabinet lock, then a fine per-drawer lock. Holding both locks, a pharmacist irreversibly dispenses a script, but only one that was never dispensed before, recording it in the dispense log and releasing both locks. An already-dispensed script encountered again is skipped and the locks are released instead of dispensing it twice. A pharmacist may crash silently, releasing any locks it held, and a crashed pharmacist may later be relieved by a replacement and rejoin. SAFETY PROPERTY: no controlled-substance script is ever dispensed twice; the dispense log never records the same script more than once.
